t: The $(9)Interdiction Matrix$() is a member of the MFFS family of machines. It imposes restrictions on players or entities present in the space around it. For example, it can be configured to automatically kill mobs or players that move into its area of effect, or to prevent unauthorised players from tampering with other machines.
$(9)干涉矩阵$()属于MFFS系列机器之一。它会对周围空间内的玩家或实体施加限制。例如，可配置为自动击杀进入其作用区域的生物或玩家，或阻止未授权玩家篡改其他机器。

The space around an $(9)Interdiction Matrix$() is split up into two logical regions: $(bold)Action$() and $(bold)Warning$(). The action region radiates out from the Matrix itself by the same number of blocks as there are $(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/scale_module)$(5)Scale Modules$() installed. By default, the warning region continues from the edge of the action region (as a concentric sphere) by an additional 3 blocks.
$(9)干涉矩阵$()周围的区域分为两个逻辑区域：$(bold)作用$()区域与$(bold)警告$()区域。作用区域从干涉矩阵本体向外延伸，延伸距离等于已安装的$(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/scale_module)$(5)扩展模块$()数量。默认情况下，警告区域从作用区域边缘（呈同心球形）再向外延伸3格。

When a player moves into the warning area of an $(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)Interdiction Matrix$(), it will send an alert message to say they have just entered its scanning range. If a player does not wish to experience first-hand which modules the Matrix has installed, they should not proceed closer. With no modules installed, an $(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)Interdiction Matrix$() doesn't really do anything. With $(l:mffs:interdiction_modules)$(5)modules$() installed, it can serve as a powerful defense system.

当玩家进入$(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)干涉矩阵$()的警告区域时，系统将发送一条提醒消息，告知其已进入扫描范围。若玩家不想亲身体验干涉矩阵已安装的模块效果，则不应继续靠近。未安装任何模块时，$(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)干涉矩阵$()基本不会产生任何效果；而安装$(l:mffs:interdiction_modules)$(5)模块$()后，它便可成为一套强大的防御系统。
